final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT sites.healtheval AS status, SUM(scans.scancount) AS total_scan_count, AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute_rate FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT status, total_scan_count, gb_per_minute_rate, gb_per_minute_rate - average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE gb_per_minute_rate > average_rate
